gen-gf-anybody-fs-ranade: Loud but gentle. Anybody flares its curve ends and packs its lowercase up tight, while Ranade spreads out in a loose, slightly rubbery plain sans line.
gen-gf-anybody-fs-supreme: Curve ends that flare gently without ever closing up mark Anybody out at the top. Supreme follows in a crisp plain sans, heavy through the middle of the line and holding its letters open.
gen-gf-anybody-general-sans: Anybody packs its lowercase up toward the caps, with curve ends that flare softly and stay apart from each other. General Sans meets that with smooth, tube-like strokes.
gen-gf-anybody-manrope: Anybody flares its curve ends and crowds its lowercase upward. Manrope then carries the text in sans-serif strokes of one width, with bright gaps at every curve, so paragraphs would move along smoothly.
gen-gf-anybody-montserrat: Bold and slightly quirky, Anybody bends like a paperclip with no swelling, while Montserrat glides beneath it on generous white space. Wire-smooth lines are what they share.
gen-gf-anybody-satoshi: Satoshi stands tall, with a soaring x-height and an e that never looks squeezed shut. Anybody is best at flared, attention-grabbing display letters; Satoshi, at quietly carrying text.
gen-gf-anybody-switzer: Switzer reads like bent wire, tubular and tall in the waist, with c tips that never drift toward touching. Switzer keeps strokes uniform from line to line, so a long page would feel steady under Anybody's flared heading.
gen-gf-anybody-work-sans: Flared and compact up top, then crisp below. Anybody's curve ends stay apart, and Work Sans echoes that with a high mean line and sans-serif strokes that look cut by one fixed nib.
gen-gf-arima-fs-bespoke-sans: Arima brings expressive, bold letters with moderate thicks and thins, and white space leaking in freely. Bespoke Sans sits below, sharp and refined, with space around every curve end.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-yaldevi: Ink strokes that taper out before they touch give Warnes its stretched, spacious look. Yaldevi takes over with outsized lowercase and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right.
